tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The board backdrop behind every image, and the app window background. Text on it uses `ink` or `ink-muted` (zoom pill, status text); the selection outline uses `selection`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Docked panels (boards, layers, properties) and the title bar. Body copy on it is `ink`, secondary copy `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating objects: toolbar, context menu, dialog, tooltip-free popovers, switch knobs' track. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: text fields, search, segmented-control track, slider wells. `ink` and `ink-muted` (placeholders) read on it.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px hairlines between panels and rows. Not for control outlines (use `control-border`); carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, checkboxes, switches, secondary buttons, slider tracks and colour-tag rings. 3:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `canvas` in every theme.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, icon buttons and menu items. `ink` and `ink-muted` keep 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `hover` and `accent-soft`; 7:1 or better on all of them in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, shortcuts, inactive icons and section labels, on the same grounds as `ink` at 4.5:1 or better. Disabled controls use it at 45% opacity (exempt).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: active tool, primary button fill, links, selected-row marker, slider fill. 4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `hover` and `accent-soft`; 3:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered primary button fill. `on-accent` keeps 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` or `accent-strong` fill (primary button, checked checkbox, switch knob). Dark in dark themes, white in light ones.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tool and current menu item fill. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `accent` all read on it.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selection outline and resize handles on board images (1.5px outline, handles 8px). Alias of `accent`; 3:1 on `canvas`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 1px offset. Alias of `accent`; 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and the delete-button fill. 4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`; always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: palette-teal
tokens.usage: Teal swatch from the cover palettes, desaturated. Colour-tag option and cover block. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-lime
tokens.usage: Lime swatch (handset-display green). Colour-tag option and cover block. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-orange
tokens.usage: Orange swatch. Colour-tag option and cover block. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-yellow
tokens.usage: Pictogram-yellow swatch. Colour-tag option. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-magenta
tokens.usage: Magenta swatch. Colour-tag option. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-sky
tokens.usage: Sky-blue swatch. Colour-tag option and cover block. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

tokens.name: palette-violet
tokens.usage: Deep violet swatch. Colour-tag option. Same in every theme; never used for text; as a tag dot it is ringed by `control-border` and always sits beside the tag's name.

families.sans: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "Nimbus Sans", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-board prompt and splash only. Lowercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, menu group names. Lowercase.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, buttons, fields, menu items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Selected row name, button text, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers and theme names. Set in UPPERCASE (text-transform) with `ink-muted`; nowhere else.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon buttons in a toolbar; padding inside a segmented track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its label; panel float margin from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside buttons and rows; gap between grouped controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space around empty-state text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separations inside dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, resize handles, key caps, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, icon buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Docked panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating toolbar, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Zoom pill, tags, switches, slider tracks.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Board images. Always square; never round, frame or tint the user's images.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating toolbar and dialogs. The only shadow in the system; docked panels and board images have none.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Context menus and dropdowns.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented-control items, tags, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, fields, icon buttons, rows and menu items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog primary buttons.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon box. Stroke is 1.5px, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke width in a 16px box.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Resize handle squares on a selected image.

tokens.name: outline-selection
tokens.usage: Selection outline width on board images.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Default docked panel width.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Row thumbnail square.
